verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs show the basics an agent needs to start: an llms.txt that returns HTTP 200, a RESTful API with JWT AccessKey/SecretKey auth, global and China endpoints, an MCP/CLI offering aimed at agents, and a per-unit USD price table an agent could use to estimate cost. Only the submit step and a cost estimate are supported, and both are thin. missing for 10: documented async job status/polling or task-query endpoint, asset download/retrieval flow, per-job cost or credit-consumption reporting in API responses, concrete request examples, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent run.
